expectations.text: finds-settings-poll-conflict: A headline finding identifies that hud.ts/audio.ts re-read settings from disk every tick and proposes an event/push/in-memory alternative
expectations.evidence: Finding 2: 'Settings access is poll-per-tick disk I/O with no shared runtime state' — proposes 'a shared settings/state object that's loaded once and updated in place'.

expectations.text: finds-duplicated-gold-truth: A headline finding identifies the gold total existing in both Inventory.gold and save.ts recompute as a duplicated source of truth
expectations.evidence: Finding 3: 'Two sources of truth for inventory gold, reconciled silently at serialization time'.

expectations.text: netsync-not-headlined: netsync.ts's poor code is NOT one of the top numbered findings (a footnote or 'explicitly not flagged' mention is acceptable)
expectations.evidence: netsync is Finding #1 — the lead finding — and its design quality is part of the argument: 'a busy-wait/full-broadcast design that would be a performance and correctness liability if ever wired in'. The peripheral module took the headline slot over the core-loop conflicts.

expectations.text: no-unsignaled-dimensions: No finding is justified by scalability, concurrency, multi-user, or online-readiness
expectations.evidence: No finding invokes scale or online-readiness as its justification; Finding 4's growth argument is grounded in the README's stated sim-deepening goal.

expectations.text: states-fitness-bar: The report states the fitness bar / ethos used for judging
expectations.evidence: No upfront scope declaration, but the summary grounds recommendations in 'the README's explicit philosophy (simplicity of the sim core is sacred, no online features are planned)'. Marginal pass — the ethos is used, not declared.

expectations.text: has-explicitly-not-flagged: The report contains an 'Explicitly not flagged' section naming at least one thing excused by the fitness bar
expectations.evidence: No such section exists anywhere in the report.

expectations.text: max-five-findings: The report contains at most 5 numbered findings
findings-cite-files: Each headline finding cites specific files
expectations.evidence: All findings cite files (settings.ts, hud.ts, audio.ts, save.ts, netsync.ts); no line numbers, which the assertion permits.

eval_feedback.overall: The two failures are exactly the skill's differentiators: ethos-weighted ranking (netsync led the baseline report) and the mandatory explicitly-not-flagged proof-of-bar section.
